title: Embedded satellite eval runners for isolated tenants
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Goal: build a lightweight, embeddable eval runner ("satellite") that customers can deploy alongside Dedicated or Private instances to execute customer-scoped evaluation suites locally, without sending examples or outputs to Redwood telemetry.

Background:
- Customers on Dedicated and Private frequently require continuous quality monitoring tied to changes in config, quantization, or model rollouts but cannot permit sensitive prompts or outputs to leave their VPC or on-prem cluster.
- Current shadow/isolated eval approaches either execute centrally (requires data export) or rely on ad-hoc customer scripts. We need a product-grade, configurable runner that integrates with Console and Optimize while preserving data isolation guarantees.

Scope:
- Deliver an embeddable binary/container (satellite) that runs locally within customer infrastructure and executes tenant-specific eval suites against pinned model artifacts or local model endpoints.
- Provide a small control plane shim in Console to orchestrate runs, collect aggregated, privacy-preserving metrics, and display results in per-tenant dashboards. Collected telemetry must be configurable to be "no-telemetry" (local-only) or "aggregate-only" (hashes, counts, DP noise).
- Support: upload of encrypted goldens (customer-managed keys), local reference corpora, cron / trigger-based runs, and Git-backed prompt bundles for reproducibility.
- Provide migration patterns for Dedicated customers to replace existing central evals.

Out of scope:
- Full-blown evaluation language or new metrics engine (we will reuse existing Optimize eval primitives initially).
- Automated patching of models; satellites only run evaluations and report metrics.

Acceptance criteria:
- Satellite container image + Helm chart (or Docker + systemd unit) documented and validated in staging with 2 Dedicated test tenants.
- Console UI: tenant-config page to register satelites, choose telemetry mode (local-only, aggregate-only), and view last 30 runs.
- Encryption: goldens and result artifacts can be stored encrypted using customer KMS; Console only receives aggregated metrics unless aggregate-only disabled by tenant.
- Audit logs: local and control-plane audit events produced for every executed run.
- E2E test harness that simulates a config change (batch size / quantization profile / model variant) and demonstrates regression detection with alert rule firing.

Success metrics:
- 80% of pilot Dedicated tenants migrate their nightly evals to satellites within 6 weeks of GA.
- Reduction in customers requesting custom on-prem eval integrations by 70% in first quarter.
- No incidents of sensitive data exfiltration in pilot (verified by internal security review and customer attestations).

Open questions / trade-offs:
- Reporting granularity vs privacy: prefer offering DP-noise injection for counts and histograms but customers may request raw counts. Need product decision on default.
- Upgrade UX for satellites: push vs pull model. Initial implementation will be pull (customer pull container image updates) to respect air-gapped environments.
- Whether to include tiny model runner for suites that require model-in-satellite (adds packaging complexity) or require calling local model endpoint only. Proposed: v1 only call local endpoints.

Rollout plan:
- Feb–Mar: design and implementation of satellite runner + console registration APIs.
- Early Apr: pilot with 2 Dedicated customers and 1 Private on-prem partner.
- Mid Apr: iterate on telemetry privacy knobs based on pilot feedback.
- Late Apr: GA for Dedicated customers, gated behind security review and documented quickstart.

Risks and mitigation:
- Risk: misconfiguration leading to accidental telemetry leakage. Mitigation: default "local-only" telemetry, end-to-end tests, and mandatory security review for any tenant enabling aggregate uploads.
- Risk: customers expect complex eval orchestration. Mitigation: clearly document limitations and provide partner services for bespoke needs.

2026-02-24 - Eng sync: Decided satellite will be a single statically-linked binary with optional docker wrapper to simplify air-gapped installs. Tracking PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/satellite/pull/37
